oracle_basis: Isochron Scepter's activated ability survives Scepter leaving; it cannot copy if the imprinted card leaves exile before resolution.
Tishana's Tidebinder may counter the Scepter activated ability when its ETB trigger exists.
Humility removes creature abilities on the battlefield and therefore suppresses Tidebinder's ETB ability.
Hope-Ender Coatl's cast trigger is created while it is a spell and remains even if the creature spell is countered.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers whenever its controller casts a spell; countering that spell does not remove the already-created Hullbreaker trigger.
invariants: Scepter and Hullbreaker use distinct resolvers
no Hullbreaker trigger is deleted merely because its source spell is countered
multiple Hullbreaker casts may create multiple independent triggers
Humility suppresses Tidebinder ETB but not Hope-Ender cast trigger
removing Humility does not retroactively create a missed ETB trigger
full Temur reservation is tracked separately from generic blue-only interaction
